implementation: Central business identity and authored runtime phone references now use the November 6 confirmation, superseding the November 2 phone instruction.
Team page uses an optional typed people collection in the existing retained-resource layout with HomeImage responsive derivatives.
Existing Calendly booking actions already use the supplied account URL. Roofr remains an instant estimate calculator, not the inspection booking provider.
Timberman Rd and Haines Ave remain project records, not additional office locations.
Review records were preserved. This change does not invent platform verification or republish unverified self-hosted reviews.
remainingDependencies: Custom quote delivery remains disconnected until a separately requested delivery integration is verified. The confirmed recipients are recorded above; no email was sent.
Lewis Center completion photographs and the selected Columbus siding case study/photos are still client-supplied dependencies.

The November 11 Search Console email reports merchant-listing offer dates on www.roofkingco.com. This Astro build does not author priced merchant Offers, so no fictional expiration was added. The affected indexed URL/schema owner and an actual offer expiry are still needed to resolve the production warning.
Domain, advertising, source-photo access and final Calendly-account confirmation stay with the people assigned in the checklist.
